text: I think unfortunately it doesn’t matter… I was delayed twice, being married and having an invitation and paperwork (both digitally submitted through the ministry and physical copy.) They didn’t care. I’m from Panama. I think it is mainly because we are from Latin America… and they believe we all want to “escape the third world by any means necessary” lol. After I got a teudat zehut it was the only way to never be questioned again.
